name: Implement
description: Implement a piece of work based on a spec or set of tickets.
longDescription: A five-line prompt that turns a spec or a set of tickets into committed code. The agent works through `/tdd` at pre-agreed seams, runs typechecking and single test files as it goes, runs the full suite once at the end, hands the finished work to `/code-review`, and commits to the current branch. Marked `disable-model-invocation: true`, so it runs only when invoked as `/implement`, never on the model's own initiative. Assumes `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` ran once in the repo.
